rationale.text: The only listed attributes are width and height on an iframe showing a video, as video embeds are written. The methodology's exception for width and height names img, object, embed, canvas and svg, not iframe. The custom check record does not fault this pair: it abstains (cannot_tell) on width and height on iframe, video, input and source, which the HTML standard treats as dimensions of embedded content; only the record supports this branch. The finding is needs_review at both levels: not_enabled at fail_only, cannot_tell at full.
